propositions: AGENTS.md wrongly states the close completion precheck requires a MERGED referencing commit, when the check runs git log with no ref and accepts any commit reachable from HEAD regardless of merge status.

The doc presents the precheck as unconditional, but it only runs when the ticket records file_impact and the completion-verification close gate is on, with additional early exits for --force-close and duplicate/supersedes links.
A referencing commit for the ticket OR any transitive descendant satisfies the check, because accepted_ids includes all descendants from list_descendants.
AGENTS.md never documents rebar transition --ref, so agents skip it when closing a stacked story against its own commit and falsely claim pre-land close is impossible.
The real land-before-close ordering rule is the adjacent Verified +1 policy line, not the precheck.
The same misstatement also appears in CONTRIBUTING.md section 2f, making both Markdown files the population in scope.
